name: Vepdegestrant (ARV-471)
reasoning: Target: estrogen receptor (ER). Modality: oral PROTAC degrader (Arvinas/Pfizer) — an emerging mechanism, not a classic antibody or small-molecule inhibitor.
Querying PubMed for the degrader mechanism and first-in-human data…
Pulling the pivotal VERITAC-2 Phase 3 readout — being precise about biomarker subgroup vs all-comers…
Cross-checking the SEC filing for the exact FDA regulatory status and PDUFA date.
Connecting silos: the ITT miss but ESR1m win explains the biomarker-defined label the FDA is reviewing.

claims.text: Vepdegestrant (ARV-471) is an orally bioavailable PROTAC that degrades the estrogen receptor by recruiting the E3 ligase cereblon (CRBN) to trigger ER ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation.
claims.quote: an oral PROTAC ER degrader that binds an E3 ubiquitin ligase and ER to directly trigger ubiquitination of ER and its subsequent proteasomal degradation

claims.text: VERITAC-2 Phase 3 — POSITIVE in the ESR1-mutant subgroup: 43% reduction in progression/death vs fulvestrant, HR 0.57 (95% CI 0.42–0.77), P<0.001; median PFS 5.0 vs 2.1 months (BICR).
claims.quote: reducing the risk of disease progression or death by 43% … [HR=0.57 (95% CI 0.42–0.77); 2-sided P<0.001]

claims.text: ATTRITION / PRECISION — VERITAC-2 did NOT reach significance in the ITT all-comers population: median PFS 3.7 vs 3.6 months, HR 0.83 (95% CI 0.68–1.02), P=0.07. The win is confined to the biomarker subgroup.
claims.quote: did not reach statistical significance in improvement in PFS in the intent-to-treat (ITT) population … [HR=0.83 (95% CI 0.68–1.02); 2-sided P=0.07]

claims.text: Vepdegestrant was first-in-human as an oral PROTAC and was well tolerated with clinical activity in pretreated ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer in Phase 1/2.
claims.quote: monotherapy was well tolerated with clinical activity in pretreated patients with ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer

claims.text: FDA accepted the NDA (2025-08-08) for ER+/HER2−, ESR1-mutated advanced/metastatic breast cancer after prior endocrine therapy — the label scope tracks the ESR1m win, not the ITT population.
claims.quote: the FDA has accepted the New Drug Application (NDA) for vepdegestrant for the treatment of patients with estrogen receptor-positive (ER+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-), ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer

claims.text: The FDA assigned a PDUFA action date of June 5, 2026; vepdegestrant also holds Fast Track designation.
claims.quote: The FDA has assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) action date of June 5, 2026

flags.text: Whether vepdegestrant is the single 'most advanced' clinical-stage PROTAC is a superlative the primary sources don't establish.
flags.reason: ranking claim not supported by a citable source — flagged rather than asserted
